notes.title: BlackJack Math 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
In this update we fixed some of the issues on the previous update and also added an exciting new feature: [b]Achievements[/b], that's unlocked based on your progress on the game.

If you already played the game and completed some of the levels you can just open the game and the achievements applied to your progress will be unlocked immediately.

The preferences you choose on the menu, such as fullscreen or window mode, audio on or off are now saved, we hope this can give you a smoother experience while playing this game.

Kind regards,

Heavy Sheep Team
